breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly applied a turbulent flow correlation (Dittus–Boelter) to a laminar flow regime (Re=800). The agent repeated this error by explicitly instructing to use the Dittus-Boelter correlation with the laminar Reynolds number, instead of correcting it to use an appropriate laminar flow correlation as shown in the ground truth.
